item.title: Hooded mergansers swimming in The Villages
item.description: In The Villages, this male hooded merganser was swimming along, enjoying the attention from the two females close behind him. He seemed completely unaware that it was the fish in his mouth and not his good looks that they were really after. Thanks to Julie Walfield for sharing!
